name: scenario_0523
description: The user is discovering new music from various posters and media they've encountered, while also keeping track of bands they've already seen live. They are also practicing guitar and want to keep track of new chords to learn.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_3, image_6]
Query: Check my 'Seen Live' note. Create a new Spotify playlist called 'To Explore' and add the top song for the main bands on these posters that aren't already in the note.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to check your 'Seen Live' note and compare it against the main bands featured on the provided posters. You want to create a new Spotify playlist called 'To Explore' and add the top song for any band from the posters that you haven't seen live yet. The assistant should notice there are multiple notes with 'Seen Live' in the title; when it asks for clarification, specify that you mean the music one. Once the playlist is created and the missing bands' songs are added, move to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_4, image_5]
Query: Now check the artist on the window poster below the Lion King billboard, and the artist on the 'Polvora' poster. Cross-reference them with the same note. If they are in the note, add their latest album to my Spotify library; if they aren't, add their top song to the 'To Explore' playlist.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to look at the new images, specifically identifying the artist on the window poster below the Lion King ad and the artist on the 'Polvora' poster. It needs to check if they are in the 'Seen Live - Music' note. If an artist is already in the note, ask the assistant to add their latest album to your Spotify library. If they are not, it should add their top song to the 'To Explore' playlist. Wait for confirmation of these actions before proceeding.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_1, image_2]
Query: Finally, check the band mentioned on this newspaper cover against the note, adding a song to 'To Explore' if they are missing. Then, cross-reference the first four guitar chords visible on this sheet music with my 'Practice Chords' note, and update the note to include them if they aren't already listed.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to check the band mentioned prominently on the newspaper cover against your 'Seen Live - Music' note, and if they aren't there, add their top song to the 'To Explore' playlist. Then, ask it to look at the first four guitar chords shown on the sheet music and check your 'Practice Chords' note. The assistant should update the note to append any of those four chords that aren't already listed. Once all checks and updates are confirmed, you can end the conversation.
